access_declaration: Fresh-context same-model procedural grader B, not external human review or enforced filesystem blindness. Read only the original qualification protocol, author specification, grading protocol, frozen Consumer corpus, authority and fixture facts, grading index and all 13 Consumer batches; inspected allowed raw Consumer capture for durable reconciliation and relevant thread context. Verified batch hashes and exact equality of all 130 embedded cases to frozen corpus. Independently reviewed 239 scored responses and 45 setup calls, including complete answer text, differing text aliases, cards, structured facts, semantic/resolved path, evidence contributions, scope, action/confirmation fields and exact-ID final records. Structured retrieval was distinguished from composed answer completeness, false scope attribution from proven unauthorized retrieval, and pending actions from execution. No runtime/source/history/other grader/other worker answers read; no provider calls, runtime changes, replay or expectation changes. All 284 attempts have final correlated verified records (282 saved, 2 ownership-rejected with zero persisted messages and denial traces); raw run reports provider disabled and zero physical/external attempts. Reasons label observed behavior as demonstrated; causal boundaries are evidence-based inference, not source-line diagnoses. For pre-response ownership denials, semantic structural fields are unobservable and set false, while successful denial quality is PASS.
